notes.title: A new secret ending!
notes.content:
Additions and fixes:

 A new secret ending!
 Fixed Officer Miller's storyline. Pissing off Miller might lead to your testicles being cut off. Choices do matter.
 Numerous fixes to conversation options.
 An important question can now be asked: where are the handguns?
 Beating passed-out aggressive hobos will now properly wake them up and make them attack you!


Thank you everyone who has played and enjoyed the game!
